purpose: Characterize current replies. These measurements do not authorize their cost or change current output defaults.

laterNormalSummaryTarget.scope: The entire outgoing JSON-RPC/tool envelope, including line delimiter, escaping, content, structuredContent and private _meta payloads.

namedBoundedExceptions.image: Explicit image and private-frame payloads remain subject to their existing encoded frame budget and transport cap; decoded image bytes are reported separately.
namedBoundedExceptions.log: Explicit requested run/log output retains its existing output/event/transport caps. Decoded run text is capped at 1048576 bytes before JSON escaping.
namedBoundedExceptions.schema: Explicit tool/resource schema listings remain subject to the existing transport cap; their whole envelope is counted.
namedBoundedExceptions.full: Explicit full element/app listings retain their existing scan, row and transport limits. Later budget work must define an envelope ceiling without changing selection semantics.

notes: Activity timestamps are intentionally beyond the fixture clock so ages are deterministically zero. The private-frame case preloads a synthetic frame cache; it is envelope accounting, not native image or desktop evidence. App fixtures omit bundles/icons so native icon discovery is never invoked. Helper request counts cover the fake daemon socket; failed input-socket connections are not requests delivered to that helper.
